title: fix(rest)!: GET /meta/app refuses a bracketed id key (?id[]=, ?id[0]=) instead of answering every app
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X7czLawmpLmMTMhtzDM1pmZ)_
Fixes #28930
Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no skill or doc page teaches the app list's `?id=` filter (`git grep` over `skills/` and `content/docs/` finds none), so nothing there names a spelling this refuses.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:应用列表 `GET /meta/app` 收到括号写法的 `id`(`?id[]=NAME`、`?id[0]=NAME`,以及任何以 `id[` 开头的键)时,答 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR` 并点名该键,不再忽略过滤、把调用者能看的整份应用列表当作结果返回。
- **为什么改**:按 qs 风格序列化数组的客户端只想取一个应用,却拿回全部应用,还会把第一个当作它要的那个来渲染;这和 #28548 修好的空 `?id=` 是同一类静默放宽。
- **风险与回滚**:只动 `packages/rest` 列表链里的一步(两条传输共用),`patch` 带 BREAKING 横幅;仅影响发送括号键的 API 调用方,`@objectstack/client` 与控制台都不发 `id`。回滚即还原本 PR。
- **先看**:`packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts`(`refuseBracketedAppIdFilter` 与第 3 步的调用);`packages/qa/dogfood/test/meta-read-doors-live.dogfood.test.ts` 末尾新块;`.changeset/28930-bracketed-app-id-refused.md`。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run src/meta-app-publish-gate.test.ts`,预期 31 个全绿,其中三条 `BRACKETED` 用例断言 400。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`?id[]=setup` and `?id[0]=setup` reach the `/meta` list chain under the key as spelled: every adapter hands query keys through unparsed (`readQuery` in `plugin-hono-server`, `readDispatchQuery` in `@objectstack/hono`). Step 3 of `createMetaListAnswer`, the one-app filter, reads `query.id` only, so it never saw them, and the caller's whole visible list came back with 200.

- `packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts`: step 3 now asks `refuseBracketedAppIdFilter(query)` first on the app list. Any query key that opens `id[` is refused with `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` and no list. The refusal uses the empty `?id=` refusal's sentence frame (#28548). Both now go through one builder, `throwListFilterRefusal`, and the empty `?id=` / `?object=` messages stay byte for byte the same:
  - empty (unchanged): `Query parameter 'id' names no app; got "". The list was not served: an empty app name is not a filter. Name one app, or leave the parameter out to list every app you can see.`
  - bracketed (new): `Query parameter 'id[]' names no app; the 'id' filter takes exactly one app name, spelled ?id=NAME. The list was not served: a bracketed 'id' key is not a filter. Name one app, or leave the parameter out to list every app you can see.`
- The refusal sits after the per-caller gate (step 2), where #28548 placed the empty refusal, and it throws to each transport's own catch. So `RestServer` and the runtime dispatcher answer it identically, through the one seam both list doors share.
- A bracketed key next to a plain `?id=` is refused too, because the request carries two spellings of one filter.

**Measured: does the seam serve other `/meta/:type` list doors?** Only the app list reads `id`. Step 3 is keyed on the folded `metaType === 'app'`, so `/meta/apps` is covered and no other type reads an `id` spelling. On every other type a bracketed `id` key stays unread, the way `?id=` is (pinned by a control). The query parse is the adapters' and is not this chain's to change. So the fix is `/meta/app` only, and the siblings are reported under Acceptance notes.

**On the order's words "the same 400 the repeated `id` gets (#28548's words)".** The repeated `id` answer is `repeatedQueryParamMessage`, which says `supplied N times`. That would be false for a key supplied once. So the bracketed key gets #28548's own refusal frame, as the claim's "extends #28548's refusal" reads. Status and code are the same as the repeated `id`'s 400.

## Tests

Measured at HEAD `2055ce23` (worktree on `claude/project-thread-vh6ns8`, base `135054eb`).

- `packages/rest/src/meta-app-publish-gate.test.ts`: `it.each(['id[]', 'id[0]', 'id[name]'])` asserts `400` + `code: VALIDATION_ERROR` + the message's first clause naming the key, with no list in the body. It runs for three caller postures, on the plural `apps`, and with a bracketed key next to a plain `id`. A control shows a bracketed `id` key on the view list is not read.
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-list-projection-parity.test.ts`: two `PARAM_PROBES` (`?id[]=crm`, `?id[0]=crm`) drive both transports over every type and caller. The census of row A grows by 2 probes × 26 type cells (991 tests). The "reference moves" test asserts the `RestServer` answer is a 400.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/meta-read-doors-live.dogfood.test.ts` (booted showcase over the Hono stack): `?id[]=setup` and `?id[0]=setup` as the admin and as a signed-up member (the `client_liaison` holder) answer `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` with `Query parameter 'id[]' names no app` and no items. Controls: `?id=showcase_app` returns one app, `?id=setup` returns `[]`, `?id=` returns 400, a repeated `id` returns 400, and no `id` returns the list, where a member never sees `setup`.

<details><summary>Red first / ablation: dropping the arm reds only the new cases</summary>

The mutation replaced the call `if (metaType === 'app') refuseBracketedAppIdFilter(query);` with `void refuseBracketedAppIdFilter;` through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, which is main's behaviour. The tool reported anchor 1 → 0, blob `9c8674a8` → `b9866803`. Then `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest build` (exit 0), and `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs @objectstack/rest "refuseBracketedAppIdFilter(query);" --absent` (exit 0, marker absent from all 6 built files).

- rest unit: `Tests 3 failed | 28 passed (31)`. The three failures are exactly the `BRACKETED id[]` / `id[0]` / `id[name]` cases.
- runtime parity: `Tests 1 failed | 990 passed (991)`. The one failure is the "reference moves" test. Row A stays green because both transports gave the same unfiltered list.
- dogfood: `Tests 2 failed | 12 passed (14)`. The failures are `?id[]=setup` and `?id[0]=setup`, which got `status: 200` with `items: [showcase_app, …]`, the card's reported answer.

Restore: `ablation-replace --restore` reported blob == HEAD `9c8674a8` and an empty `git diff HEAD`. The rebuild exited 0, and the preflight showed the marker present in 2 built files with a clean tree. A first ablation attempt deleted the line outright. The now-unused function then failed the rest DTS build (exit 1), and that run was discarded.
</details>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest test`: exit 0, `Test Files 366 passed (366)`, `Tests 6940 passed | 332 skipped (7272)`
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest typecheck`: exit 0
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/domains/meta-list-projection-parity.test.ts`: exit 0, `Tests 991 passed (991)`

## Acceptance notes

- **Premise.** The card and the order place the filter in `packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts`. It lives in `packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts` (`createMetaListAnswer`, step 3), the chain both transports call. The defect reproduced as stated (see the ablation leg).
- **The dogfood stack has no `setup` app.** `bootShowcase` serves only `showcase_app` to both callers. The card's `setup` comes from a full `os dev` boot. The bracketed probe still uses `setup` as the order asks, and on main it answered the whole list (`[showcase_app]`). The narrowing control uses `?id=showcase_app`, and `?id=setup` → `[]`.
- **Sibling, same class (finding, not fixed here).** `GET /meta/view?object[]=lead` answers every view with 200, where `?object=lead` answers one. This was measured through `RestServer`'s `GET /meta/:type` route handler with a three-view fixture: `object[]` gave `200 ["all_leads","acct_view","loose_view"]` and `object=` gave `200 ["all_leads"]`. The adapters pass the key through the same way, so the view switcher's filter is dropped the same way. Not measured: `package[]` on the list doors (`?package=` scopes the read, and an unread key would read as "every package").
- **Overlap.** Open PR #28850 also edits `meta-read-doors-live.dogfood.test.ts`, in its header comment and the acceptance[2] setup. This PR only appends a `describe` block at the end of the file, so the hunks do not meet. No other open PR touches `meta-item-read-gate.ts`, `rest-server.ts`, the rest unit file or the runtime parity file. Every open PR was checked by diff names; #28731 was checked through its file list.

## Verification

All local readings are at HEAD `2055ce23`. Every family CI runs is cited from this PR's check-runs in the report, and none of them was re-run here.

- **Derived gate set** (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`, from the merge-base): 64 commands run, all exit 0. `--ran` reconciliation answers `64 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 64 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`. Two first-pass exit 3s were prerequisites, not reds, and each was re-run green:
  - `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` needed its pinned commit on this shallow clone (`git fetch --depth=1 origin 621a4876…`).
  - `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` read 7 packages with no `dist/`. After they were built, it reported `115 published require entry point(s) across 70 package(s) load`.
  The record is `pm-orders/server/28930-gates-ran.txt` in the project files.
- **Full dogfood battery** (the `(narrowing)` arm owes it): `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under the verify lock, after the `@objectstack/dogfood^...` closure build. `VERDICT command-exit 0` · `Test Files 383 passed | 3 skipped (386)` · `Tests 3166 passed | 28 skipped (3194)`.
- **Not run locally:** `test:repo` (the vitest `repo` projects, which belong to CI Test Core) and `pnpm lint` (a repo-wide scan owned by CI). The one `repo`-project file this diff edits, `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-list-projection-parity.test.ts` (listed in `packages/runtime/vitest.repo-tests.json`), was run directly (991/991). The rest of that project is left to CI.
